_doc: Render service registry read by scripts/render.sh as ./services.json. Keep it next to the skill's scripts/ dir. CI (a workflow like backend-image.yml that builds the image and triggers the deploy) is the primary deploy path; this script and its entries are the fallback for when CI is unavailable. After `render.sh create <service>`, fill the returned id back into serviceId.

my-api._planNote: free tier exists but cold-starts and can be suspended; plan for paid in production
my-api._envNote: envFile is a JSON array of {key, value, type} entries (type: plain|encrypted); values must not sit in any committed file
